name: Late Amusement
storyline:
For Liam, a young high school student, writing his own stories is one of his favorite hobbies, which is why he is always on the lookout for the latest inspiration. He likes to visit old abandoned places for inspiration and gets scared and inspired there.
One day, he finds an old newspaper article about an abandoned amusement park nearby that he had never heard of. As he reads the article, he thinks to himself, "This is the best source of inspiration ever! "I have to go there right now!", so he packs his things and drives there one evening. When he arrives there, it seems a bit strange, but not so much that he would leave. However, he soon realizes that he is not alone, but it is already too late.
He is now trapped in the park, forced to play the games of the souls that live there, survive them, and find out what really happened in the park back then.
summary: Were they all just accidents, or were they? Late Amusement is a first-person survival horror from a small indie studio. You play as young student Liam Snow and survive for as long as you can to uncover the secrets of the theme park.
